amendments.after_access: No parameter/window/threshold/primary-test changes to rescue results. Technical corrections need logged cause, impact, amended hashes and transparent rerun of affected work without reselection.
amendments.before_access: Version the draft and obtain explicit user approval of the final hash; retain previous versions

approval.approval_source: Direct human message in this task
approval.condition: Owned execution/source/environment seal before first 2026 price bytes
approval.user_approval_text: I approve the protocol and risk limits, but use 1 Jan–30 Sep 2026 as the partial-year OOS window. Freeze that amendment before accessing 2026, then run all nine unchanged strategies.

execution.archive_failure: Stop; no unexplained filling, shortening, symbol substitution or silent API fallback
execution.cash_reset: One independent cash start for OOS; terminal liquidation once at end; no monthly/annual resets
execution.historical_warmup: Preserve full October 2021 onward historical warmup and lifecycle rewarm inside each exact basket
execution.lag1_caveat: Idealized observed-close execution, NOT a literal one-hour delay; lag2 adds one hour
execution.lifecycle: Legacy LUNA/LUNC, FTM/S and MATIC/POL keep source-backed economic lineages, cash gaps, rewarm and vacant slots; no Terra2 or survivor replacement
execution.missing_or_unexplained_data: Block the final evaluation rather than fill/drop periods or strategies; retain any provisional failures with explicit status
execution.monthly_fitted_model_refits: Not applicable: all nine are nonfactor fixed trailing-return strategies
execution.source: Same Binance spot hourly source; official monthly archives and verified SHA256 sidecars by default
execution.turnover: Full-L1 target changes including entry, forced/lifecycle events and terminal liquidation; ordinary drift maintenance omitted

inference.assumptions: Approximately stationary weakly dependent daily net returns; inference and familywise calibration are approximate, not exact finite-sample guarantees
inference.bankruptcy_policy: Full hourly wealth nonpositive/noncompoundable => economic/risk failure, no growth/Sharpe/boot inference fabricated, primary adjustment p=1

bootstrap.draw: ceil(n/28) uniform block starts on [0,n); concatenate modulo-n blocks and truncate to n
bootstrap.invalid_bootstrap_sharpe: Do not drop; any invalid draw makes Sharpe interval unavailable
bootstrap.invalid_bootstrap_t: Conservative tail exceedance; do not drop; any invalid draw makes studentized intervals/bounds unavailable
bootstrap.method: synchronized circular moving blocks on the nine daily net-return vectors
bootstrap.null_centering: Subtract each observed strategy mean before resampling for the primary one-sided t test

inference.degenerate_case_policy: Observed HAC variance nonpositive/nonfinite or sample SD zero => t/Sharpe undefined as applicable, adjustment p=1, no statistical pass; all-cash return zero is not missing data
inference.failure_aware_future_adapter: The pure analyze_nine reference requires nine finite compoundable columns. The future adapter must preserve all nine identity/status slots, use one common 273-day bootstrap index matrix on valid columns only, and assign only the adjustment p=1 to bankrupt/unavailable cases without inventing return paths or zero-filled columns. Independently test that failure-aware orchestration; shared calendar/data/code errors still block final claims.

hac.normal_approximation_pvalue: 1-Phi(t_HAC), reported secondary only; cannot substitute for primary result
hac.primary_pvalue: Centered circular block-bootstrap-t; not an exact Student t calibration

inference.hourly_drawdown_interval: Not estimated from daily bootstrap; hourly point episode/dates and duration remain authoritative
inference.hypotheses: For each fixed strategy i: H0 E[r_it] <= 0 versus H1 E[r_it] > 0

intervals.scope: marginal approximate descriptive; full CAGR equivalence only after complete-scope reconciliation

intervals.method: One-sided Bonferroni lower bound using bootstrap t quantile 1-0.05/9
intervals.scope: approximate simultaneous familywise 95% lower bounds; not Holm-inverted intervals and not a second success gate

inference.missing_day_policy: No deletion, filling, date compression or independent calendars; inference blocked if exact common contiguous daily scope cannot be supplied

multiplicity.ordering: Primary p ascending; fixed comparison_id order for ties

inference.power_caveat: Nine months /273 days and approximately9.75 28-day block lengths may yield wide intervals and no Holm rejection; nonsignificance is not proof of no edge
inference.primary_metric: Expected arithmetic complete-UTC-day net simple return versus zero-interest cash
inference.risk_scope: Same-path complete contiguous UTC days, including flat days and their actual fees; no relocated boundary fees or risk-slice resimulation

required_deliverables: Nine primary inference rows with raw/adjusted p, t, intervals, invalid-draw counts and all criterion flags
Joint daily net-return matrix and synchronized bootstrap index SHA/seed metadata
All nine full-hour paths, targets, fills/forced events and cost/turnover audit paths
Per-strategy full risk/performance metrics including dates/duration and exposure/BTC attribution
Track A and Track B descriptive tables with unchanged identities; no ensemble or superiority claims
Provenance, explicit approval/access chronology, code/environment/data seals and independent accounting/inference audit
Executed notebook, readable report and final acceptance with prior artifact preservation

scientific_limitations.2026_projectwide_status: Retrospective temporal evaluation with prior January-September 2026 exposure; not pristine blind/prospective OOS
scientific_limitations.Holm_scope: Only these nine primary claims, conditional on approximate p-value validity; not a correction for earlier million-pair searches or prior 2026 exposure
scientific_limitations.bootstrap_scope: Conditional resampling of realized strategy returns, not a re-run of earlier selection, future-regime guarantee or realistic execution model
scientific_limitations.future_confirmation: Truly prospective confirmation requires observations after the final approved protocol freeze; no monitoring or live trading is authorized
scientific_limitations.implementation: Theoretical shorting; omitted funding/borrow, ordinary drift maintenance, capacity and realistic slippage/fills; spot data do not establish deployability
scientific_limitations.restart_status: This restart has not loaded/evaluated 2026; a new freeze cannot erase earlier project-wide inspection

selection.track_comparisons: Descriptive individual metrics and counts, not a paired superiority test or an ensemble return.

source_policy.profile: byte-pinned existing official monthly archive panels; no new download needed if all pins pass
source_policy.warmup_start: October2021 as inherited exact audited endpoint grid

success_criteria.data_accounting_required: All source/engine/coverage/accounting checks valid, full declared period, no unexplained scope losses
success_criteria.data_or_code_failure: Evaluation blocked/not evaluable, not a market-performance failure
success_criteria.economic_pass: Primary full-hour compounded net total return > 0
success_criteria.full_research_support: economic_pass AND statistical_pass AND drawdown<=0.40 AND turnover_pass, with all validity checks passed
success_criteria.negative_or_zero_realized_return: Economic criterion not met; not by itself proof that expected return is nonpositive
success_criteria.risk_budget_rationale: 40% and 1.5x are explicit user-approved governance tolerances, not optimized estimates, universal rules or inherited selection conditions
success_criteria.risk_limit_handling: Evaluate full unchanged paths; budgets are ex-post research acceptance flags, not newly introduced intra-run exits
success_criteria.risk_or_turnover_breach: Risk/turnover expectation not met, even if expected-return evidence is positive
success_criteria.statistical_pass: Valid primary test with observed HAC t > 0 AND Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05
success_criteria.turnover_pass: OOS annualized full-L1 turnover <= 1.5 * max(saved development annualized turnover, saved validation annualized turnover), using unrounded registry limits
success_criteria.unavailable_inference: Not statistically supported; retain unavailable status rather than an invented t or zero Sharpe

user_authorized_scope: All nine unchanged strategies, Jan1–Sep30 2026, approved risk limits and statistical rules

window.partial_year_change: Explicit human-approved pre-access amendment; no result-based choice by the engine
window.performance_accounting: start < bar_end <= end; exclude candles opening at cutoff
